title: 第676章 有了第675章 北境的规矩
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：全族助我加点，我举族飞升天界第二卷：北玄领主第676章有了！（..la）万花主宰看向李北玄继续说道，“北玄道友，还是建议你重新审视一下你的这个盟友吧！”
说着她将目光看向一旁的天都主宰。
“别到时候泛海古迹之行什么好处都没捞到，白白错过了这个机会！”
听到万花主宰这般说辞，天都主宰顿时就不乐意了。
“万花主宰，话可不能这么说！”他看向万花主宰反驳道。
“万宙奇观，我只是想想罢了，并没有真正想去！”
“况且，我等若是一直安于现状，未来谁有把握一定能够渡过归墟大劫！”
说着，他看向万花主宰以及一旁的李北玄。
“仅凭泛海古迹之中的资源，根本不足以让我等尽可能的提升实力！”
“我之所以这么想，不也是为了我北境着想吗？”
万花主宰看向天都主宰，脸上浮现一抹冷笑，“天都主宰，你只需要管好你自己便好，至于我等该怎样去提升实力，那是我等自己的事情！”
说着，她目光看向李北玄，“北玄道友，如今喜宴已经结束，这段时间该说的我已经告诉你了。”
“刚刚我跟你说的话，你自己再好好想想！”
说着，她转头看了一眼面色不慎的天都主宰。
最后对李北玄说了一句，“北玄道友，期待东陵小会再与你相聚！”
说完，没有理会天都主宰的目光，她的身影便已然消失在了北玄宫中。
天都主宰看到万花主宰已经离去，他的脸上方才缓和下来。
想到自己刚刚的那番话，他转头看向李北玄拱手道，“北玄道友，让你见笑了！”
“不过你放心便是，我天都并非鲁莽之人，此番能与你结盟，泛海古迹之行不会让你失望的！”
“至于万宙奇观，道友就当我没说过便是！”

他确实不应该存了邀请李北玄前去探险的意思。
毕竟李北玄也才突破主宰之境十多万年时间，与其他主宰相比，这其中可就不是一星半点的差距了。
每一个存在了无数岁月的主宰，又有哪一个会是简单的。
这也是刚刚万花主宰为何会说出那番言论，正是因为她知道其中的利害得失。
李北玄见天都主宰主动承认自己说错话，并保证泛海古迹之行。
“天都道友，我能理解你的心情，不过刚刚万花主宰之言你也莫要放在心上。”
“她也是为了我好！”李北玄看向天都主宰出言说道。
“不过道友放心便是，你我既然已经结盟，那我等便是盟友，不管泛海古迹之行是否有收获，也都不会怪你！”
说着，李北玄脸上多了一抹笑容，“希望到时候你可不要怪我拖你后腿才是！”
天都主宰听见李北玄这么说，脸上终于是恢复了笑容，“怎么会！”
“不过有北玄道友你的这句话我便放心了！”
说着，他缓缓站起身来继续说道，“北玄道友，此行出来也有些时日，我也该回去了！”
李北玄起身对其拱手回道，“好，那我等东陵小会再聚！”
天都主宰点了点头，“期待下次相聚！”
说完，他的身影也随之消失在了北玄宫中。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: The whole clan helps me add some points, and my whole clan ascends to heaven. Volume 2: Chapter 676 of Lord Beixuan is here! (..la) The Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers looked at Li Beixuan and continued, "Fellow Taoist Beixuan, I suggest you re-examine this ally of yours!"
As she spoke, she looked at the Lord of Heaven on the side.
“Don’t miss out on this opportunity by not reaping any benefits from your trip to Panhai Monuments!”
After hearing what the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers said, the Lord of Heaven was immediately unhappy.
"Master of Ten Thousand Flowers, you can't say that!" He looked at the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers and retorted.
"I'm just thinking about the wonders of the universe, I don't really want to go!"
"Besides, if we continue to be content with the status quo, who is sure that we will be able to survive the catastrophe of Guixu in the future!"
As he spoke, he looked at the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers and Li Beixuan beside him.
"The resources in Oceanwide Ancient Monuments alone are simply not enough for us to increase our strength as much as possible!"
"Isn't the reason why I think this way also for the sake of my northern territory?"
Lord Wanhua looked at Lord Tiandu, with a sneer on his face, "Lord Lord Tiandu, you only need to take care of yourself. As for how I should improve my strength, that is my own business!"
As she said that, she looked at Li Beixuan and said, "Fellow Taoist Beixuan, now that the wedding banquet is over, I have told you what you need to say during this period."
"Think about what I just told you!"
As she said that, she turned her head and glanced at the Lord of Heaven who looked careless.
Finally, he said to Li Beixuan, "Fellow Taoist Beixuan, I look forward to seeing you again at Dongling Xiaohui!"
After saying that, she ignored the gaze of the Lord of Heaven and disappeared into Beixuan Palace.
When Lord Tiandu saw that Lord Ten Thousand Flowers had left, his face softened.
Thinking of what he just said, he turned to look at Li Beixuan and cupped his hands and said, "Fellow Taoist Beixuan, I made you laugh!"
"But don't worry, I am not a reckless person. If I can form an alliance with you this time, you will not be disappointed during the trip to the Panhai Ancient Monuments!"
"As for the wonders of the universe, fellow Taoist, just pretend that I didn't say anything about it!"
He really shouldn't have any intention of inviting Li Beixuan to explore.
After all, Li Beixuan has only broken through the realm of dominion for more than 100,000 years. Compared with other dominators, there is not even a slight difference.
Of all the masters who have existed for countless years, there is no one who can be simple.
This is why the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers made those remarks just now, precisely because she knew the pros and cons involved.
Li Beixuan saw that the Lord of Tiandu took the initiative to admit that he had said something wrong and promised to visit the Panhai historic sites.
"Fellow Daoist Tiandu, I can understand your mood, but you should not take what the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers said just now to heart."
"She is also doing it for my own good!" Li Beixuan looked at the Lord of Heaven and said.
"But fellow Taoist, don't worry. Since you and I have formed an alliance, then we are allies. No matter whether the trip to Panhai Ancient Monuments is fruitful or not, I won't blame you!"
As he said that, a smile appeared on Li Beixuan's face, "I hope you won't blame me for holding you back when the time comes!"
When the Lord of Tiandu heard what Li Beixuan said, the smile finally returned to his face, "How could it be!"
"But with your words, Fellow Daoist Beixuan, I feel relieved!"
With that said, he slowly stood up and continued, "Fellow Daoist Beixuan, it's been a while since I left this trip, and it's time for me to go back!"
Li Beixuan stood up and cupped his hands and replied, "Okay, then I'll meet again at the Dongling gathering!"
Lord Tiandu nodded, "Looking forward to our next meeting!"
After saying that, his figure disappeared into Beixuan Palace.
